concerns.text: The 'WISE' benchmark URLs cited (e.g., pythainlp/wisesight_sentiment) are Thai sentiment analysis datasets, not the visual reasoning benchmarks required for the 'InterleaveThinker' extension. The plan requires a dataset containing image prompts and ground-truth scene descriptions to test the 'structure vs. modality' hypothesis. Using sentiment data renders the simulator and agentic loop inapplicable to the research question.

The 'RISE' benchmark URLs cited (e.g., CyberHarem/rise_neuralcloud, Gopher-Lab/...Ethereums_Dencun_Upgrade) appear to be unrelated to the standard RISE (Reasoning in Structured Environments) or similar visual reasoning benchmarks. These sources do not provide the necessary image-prompt/scene-description pairs required to validate the text-based simulator against visual grounding gaps.

The 'SFT-80k' and 'SFT-112k' datasets cited (e.g., ubowang/webinstruct_sft_gpt4o) are general instruction-following datasets. They lack the specific 'image prompt -> structured JSON scene description' pairs needed to train or evaluate the 'Scene Simulator' and 'Critic' agents for the specific task of spatial reasoning validation. The plan assumes these general SFT datasets can substitute for domain-specific visual reasoning data without justification.
